item.title: Celebrus Technologies: close to inflection point, this cash-rich group’s shares have an upward momentum, AGM this Thursday, shares 104p, cash 58p
item.summary: What do Bank of America, Citi, Qantas, HSBC, Lloyds, Toyota, Nationwide, BNP Paribas and The Very Group all have in common? The simple answer is that they are just a handful of clients of the £39.5m-capitalised Celebrus Technologies (LON:CLBS). Using its patented digital identity data technology, the group’s clients include global leaders in Banking, Retail, Travel, Healthcare, and all major industries.
